verdict.rationale: Insomnia organizations let users share collections and environments with colleagues [insomnia-docs-12]. Projects can be stored as Cloud Sync or Git Sync [insomnia-docs-32], with in-app merge-conflict resolution [insomnia-docs-23] and end-to-end protected sync [insomnia-docs-34]. Collaboration supports unlimited contributors [insomnia-docs-42] and RBAC controls who can access which resources [insomnia-docs-11]. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how Cloud Sync shared-workspace syncing behaves (real-time vs manual push/pull), and independent or hands-on corroboration of team syncing.
